Terms, in plain words

For every Småverk tool: Captions, Vertical, Clip finder, Clips and Operator. Last updated 2026-09-27. By using a tool or buying a key you accept these terms.

What you get

Each tool has a free version and a paid version, and each tool's page states its own limits. Operator is free while it is a preview; it has no paid version yet. In Captions and Vertical the free version handles clips up to 60 seconds and saves them with a small smaverk.com mark in the corner, and the paid version removes the mark and handles clips up to five minutes. In Clip finder the free version reads recordings up to 30 minutes and shows every moment it finds, and the paid version reads recordings up to four hours and saves every export: the clip itself and the timeline files. In Clips the free version finds the moments in recordings up to four hours and makes clips of up to 90 seconds that you can watch (MP4, 9:16, as tall as the recording: 608×1080 from 1080p video), and saves one clip with a small smaverk.com mark; the paid version saves every clip, with no mark. You pay once per tool; the price is on that tool's page. Each tool is its own purchase with its own key. A key opens the tool or tools it was bought for, and the tool tells you which those are. A Clips key also opens the three tools Clips is built from: Captions, Vertical and Clip finder.

Paying once buys a key for the paid version of that tool, as the tool is offered. It is a licence to use the tool, not a share in it. It is not a promise that the tool will be offered, or stay the same, for any set length of time. If we stop offering a tool, we say so on its page at least 30 days before.

Who sells it

You buy through Polar Software, Inc., our merchant of record. Polar takes the payment, adds the right tax for your country, sends the receipt, and is the seller on your statement. Polar's buyer terms apply to the purchase. Småverk makes the tools and gives support.

Refunds

In the first 14 days after you pay, you can ask for your money back, no questions asked. Write to hello@smaverk.com from the email you paid with, and the full amount is refunded through Polar. After a refund the key stops working. We do this once per person, per tool.

The paid version starts working the moment you pay, and you agree to that when you buy. In the EU that agreement normally ends the 14-day right to withdraw, so the 14 days above are given in its place and are the same length. After them we do not refund, unless the law of your country gives you a right we cannot set aside.

What the tools do, and what we do not promise

  • Captions are written automatically, on your device. They are made for English and can be wrong, especially with noise or strong accents. Check the words before you post.
  • Vertical keeps the speaker in the picture automatically. With two people in the shot, or a face that is small or turned away, it can pick the wrong spot. Watch the result before you post; Hold still lets you place the window yourself.
  • Operator films the people in front of the camera. Film only people who know they are being filmed and agree to it. It can miss someone, film someone twice or cut to the wrong person, and a phone that cannot zoom from a web page gets crops rather than a closer lens. Watch the result before you share it.
  • The tools work in current versions of Safari, Chrome and Edge. Old browsers, old devices, low memory or unusual video files can make them slow or make them fail. How fast they are depends on your device.
  • Try the free version with your own kind of clip on your own device before you buy. It is the same tool with a shorter limit and the mark.

The tools are provided as they are. Beyond what is written on this page, and as far as the law allows, we make no promise that they are free of faults, fit a particular purpose, give a particular result, or are available without breaks.

Changes, and the end of a tool

We may change, improve, limit or remove features, change prices for new buyers, and stop offering a tool. If a change we make stops a paid feature from working for you, write to us and we will try to put it right within a reasonable time. We owe nothing more for a change, except what the law of your country requires. The 30 days' notice above applies to stopping a tool.

Your key

One key per purchase, for your own use on your own devices. Do not share, publish, resell or rent it. We may switch off a key that was shared, published, refunded or charged back. If your key leaks by accident, write to us and we replace it once.

Your clips, and your use of the tools

Your clips are yours. They stay on your device, and we get no rights in them. You may use what you make for your own work, paid or not. You are responsible for your clips: that you have the right to use what is in them, for what you make from them, and for where you post it. Do not use the tools to break the law or someone else's rights. Do not copy, resell or take apart the tools, or try to get around the limits or the key. The tools, the name Småverk and these sites belong to us.

Limits on what we are liable for

As far as the law allows, we are not liable for lost income, lost views, lost clips or data, missed deadlines, or any indirect loss. The most we can owe you in total for a tool is what you paid for it. For the free version that is nothing. None of this limits liability that the law does not allow us to limit, such as for harm caused on purpose or by gross carelessness.

If you buy as a consumer

Nothing in these terms takes away rights that the consumer law of your country gives you and that cannot be set aside by agreement. Where such a right applies, it applies; everything else on this page still stands.

Law and disputes

Swedish law applies to these terms. Disputes go to the courts of Sweden. If you are a consumer in the EU you also keep the protection of your own country's law and may use the courts where you live. Write to us first: most things are solved by one email.

Changes to these terms

We may update this page; the date at the top shows the latest version. The terms in force on the day you bought apply to that purchase. If part of these terms cannot be applied, the rest still stands.
